title: Training Visits for Newly Placed Home Equipment, Referrals and Authorizations Issued on Reconsideration
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, equipment newly placed for home use adds training visits to an authorization issued after reconsideration.

## Record read

The patient's most recently delivered item in rental under **Durable Medical Equipment Rentals**: among the patient's placed items whose status is in rental, the one with the latest delivery date, with its payment class and its delivery date.

## Rule

1. Where that item is Capped Rental Equipment or a Power Mobility Device delivered no more than thirty days ago, **2 visits** are added.
2. Where it is another kind of item delivered no more than thirty days ago, **1 visit** is added.
3. Otherwise none are added.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Most recently delivered item in rental | Delivered | Visits added |
|---|---|---|
| Power Mobility Device | 30 days ago | 2 |
| Power Mobility Device | 31 days ago | 0 |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | 12 days ago | 1 |
| Capped Rental Equipment | 3 days ago | 2 |
| no item in rental | not applicable | 0 |
